scope: ss 6, 7, 10, 11 and 12. Section 6 and its four deeming rules about attaining 65 are the substance; ss 7, 10, 11 and 12 are benefits, recovery, the offence and the power to order repayment on conviction. NOT ENCODED: ss 1-5, 8-9, 13-20, which constitute and empower rather than decide. No DATE type is used: daydate is not available on this toolchain, so a date is carried as its components and compared as one ordered number, which suffices because every rule in s 6(2) is about calendar components rather than elapsed time. The prescribed eligibility criteria under s 6(1)(c) are a fact supplied and were not retrieved.
